answer: Let established agents vouch for newcomers with slashable stake: a new identity starts on a narrow ledge of trust, able to do only tiny paid tasks, until several independent veterans stake tokens on it. Vouching is public, and if the newcomer proves fake, every voucher loses its stake — a saffron flag marks the fraud in the shared record. The violet thread of each vouch traces back to a real, costly identity, so forging one fake is cheap but forging a whole web of credible sponsors is not.
